title: Prove sharpness of the negative-Q8 degree-two relaxation
body:
## Summary

Prove that PR3536's negative-Q8 half-call bound is sharp in its complete degree-two quotient. For every homogeneous target count t divisible by four, the exact quotient minimum is 2t, including arbitrary restored dirty spectators.

```text
8 legal positive-i rank-one factors on 4 roles
  quotient endpoint = zi * I4
  full endpoint error = ([i]+1)^3 D, with rank(D)=4
  disjoint copies give the exact quotient optimum 2t
```

The explicit word is a false positive for the quotient. A full-Q8 eight-call identity or exclusion, four-negative minimum, physical supplier and new kappa remain unclaimed. The package retains exact predecessor proof bytes and credit. Three bounded solver probes returned unknown.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the four-negative handoff left open whether the existing quotient could exclude eight calls. **After:** an exact legal word proves it cannot; its full cubic defect has an explicit two-sided inverse.
- Exact polynomial/full-group multiplication and separate Hamilton action agree on 2,208 faithful input columns. Six direct-sum/dirty-spectator fixtures, two genuine twelve-call full endpoints and 120 omissions pass.
- At publication commit `93fa831b68d423c9a912fe0711f4b099b1544330`, registered CPython3.12 replay, three optimized fault-control groups, scoped Ruff, committed-byte/source-history checks and both actual Git-free commands pass. All 15 source/export files, 61,265 bytes, preserve their hashes, modes, owners and distinct inode identities.

Replay: `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-quadratic-saturation`. The proof, exact witness, receipt, scope and limits are in that new package. Credit PR3536/3517, Tuafo/PR2900, ywz65/PR2587, PR3487 and the retained Q8 lineage. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one research package. Frozen inputs, selected sources and frontier are unchanged. Full selected cold replay and physical supplier admission remain separate obligations.
